OBS Donut Ride

Oklahoma City, OK · Will Rogers Park · Road · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

OBS Donut Ride is a road and social group ride in Oklahoma City, OK. It rolls every Saturday at 9:04 am from Will Rogers Park Tennis Center, east end of parking lot. About 12 miles, entry level, set by the slowest rider. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:04 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: entry level, set by the slowest rider. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the OBS Donut Ride group ride

About 12 miles round trip to a donut shop and back. The pace is set by the slowest rider, and nobody gets dropped. Runs every Saturday of the year, weather permitting. A good first group ride in OKC.
